turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on that zero, and when?
Funny. My son found out from his phone in the middle of class. Who decided?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You just told me my son cheated, with nothing in your hand. Owen doesn't lie, so show me what you have or I'm walking down to the principal.
